t: Connect Multiple Facebook Pages to Eleva Sub-account
html:
We are excited to announce the release of one of the most asked integration features - connecting multiple Facebook pages.


TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What's new?
  • Connect Multiple Facebook Accounts
  • Why is this feature important?
  • Coming soon:


What's new?

  • Leads Sync: Sync leads automatically from Facebook Lead Ads across multiple pages with clear attribution to the source
  • Conversations: Chat with customers across multiple Facebook pages using Facebook and Instagram chat integrations
  • Automation: Build customised workflows to automate customer engagement across multiple Facebook pages
  • Reputation: Manage reviews and your review responses across multiple Facebook pages


Connect Multiple Facebook Accounts


You can now connect multiple Facebook accounts to one Eleva sub-account, with multiple Facebook Pages under each account.


Previously, users could connect multiple Pages under only one Facebook account.


With the Marketplace enhancement, you can:

  • Sync leads across connected Pages.
  • Manage Facebook messaging across multiple accounts.
  • Run automations across supported Pages.

To add another account, open Facebook Marketplace → External Connection → Add Account.


Note: Shops and Ad Accounts remain limited to one Facebook account.



Why is this feature important?

This was one of the most asked Integration features on Canny, with 800+ votes. This feature will enable customers across a spectrum of use-cases - SMBs managing multiple outlets, to influencers managing multiple fan pages.

Coming soon:

  • Mobile App: The Eleva mobile app currently does not support conversations across multiple Facebook pages.
  • Conversation AI: Conversation AI currently does not support auto-response to messages across multiple Facebook pages.





Troubleshooting: Facebook Page Not Showing


If the Facebook page you want to connect does not appear in the list during setup, it is typically due to permission or access issues.


Important: Facebook pages are made available based on the permissions of the Facebook user account you connect. Eleva does not connect directly to Facebook Business Manager or Ad Accounts.



Check the following:

  • Ensure you have Admin access to the Facebook Page (not just Editor or partial access)

  • Confirm you are logged into the correct Facebook profile connecting

  • During the connection step, make sure you grant all requested permissions

  • If access was recently updated, try disconnecting and reconnecting Facebook in Settings → Integrations


For a complete step-by-step troubleshooting guide (including Eleva permissions, Business Manager settings, and lead access issues), refer to:

Facebook Multi Page Troubleshoot
